title: PracticePay Patient Financing Plan Schedule: Promotion, Term, APR and Payment Method
content:
PracticePay Patient Financing offers seven closed-end plans. The schedule below fixes, for each plan, its promotional structure, the length of its promotional period, the number of monthly payments, the plan APR, how the monthly payment is set and rounded, the smallest monthly payment, how interest is charged and when the monthly statement closes.

## Promotion, term and rate

| Plan | Promotional structure | Promotional period (months from the purchase date) | Monthly payments in the term | Plan APR (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | deferred interest | 6 | 24 | 26.99 |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | no interest | 6 | 6 | 0.00 |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | deferred interest | 12 | 36 | 26.99 |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | no interest | 12 | 12 | 0.00 |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | reduced APR | 0 | 24 | 9.99 |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | reduced APR | 0 | 48 | 14.99 |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | standard | 0 | 60 | 21.99 |

A promotional period of 0 months means the plan has none. The plan APR is the rate deferred interest accrues at on a deferred-interest plan, the fixed APR on a reduced-APR or standard plan, and 0.00 on a no-interest plan.

## Monthly payment and interest

| Plan | How the monthly payment is set | How interest is charged |
|---|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | level payment that repays the financed amount at the plan APR over the term | not applicable |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | financed amount divided equally over the term | not applicable |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | level payment that repays the financed amount at the plan APR over the term | not applicable |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | financed amount divided equally over the term | not applicable |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | level payment at the plan APR over the term | simple daily interest at the plan APR on the plan balance excluding fees, charged at each statement closing |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | level payment at the plan APR over the term | simple daily interest at the plan APR on the plan balance excluding fees, charged at each statement closing |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | level payment at the plan APR over the term | simple daily interest at the plan APR on the plan balance excluding fees, charged at each statement closing |

Terms that are the same on every plan:

- **Rounding of the monthly payment:** rounded up to the next cent; the final payment absorbs the difference.
- **Smallest monthly payment for any plan:** 25.00 USD.
- **Statement closing:** the monthly statement closes 21 calendar days before each due date.

## Reading the schedule

- A no-interest plan has an APR of 0.00 and charges no interest; its payment is the financed amount shared equally over its payments.
- The 6-month and 12-month deferred-interest plans carry the same plan APR of 26.99 but differ in promotional period (6 against 12 months) and in term (24 against 36 payments).
- Every plan applies the same 25.00 USD floor to its monthly payment, whatever its method.
